summary_en: This Phase 2 study compares systemic therapy with and without liver-directed radiation therapy in patients with advanced intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma. Durvalumab, gemcitabine and cisplatin are given by IV, and patients must receive at least 4 cycles of systemic therapy; the dosing schedule and total duration are not stated. The main outcome is not stated; the study is a Phase 2 trial.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 compara la terapia sistémica con y sin radioterapia dirigida al hígado en pacientes con colangiocarcinoma intrahepático avanzado. Durvalumab, gemcitabina y cisplatino se administran por vía intravenosa, y los pacientes deben recibir al menos 4 ciclos de terapia sistémica; el esquema de dosis y la duración total no se indican. El resultado principal no se indica; el estudio es un ensayo de fase 2.
who_for: Adults aged 18 or older at study entry.
Pathology-confirmed intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma with at least one tumor 3 cm or larger.
Unresectable liver-confined disease, or spread to non-regional lymph nodes, lung, or bone.
Received at least 4 cycles of gemcitabine, cisplatin and durvalumab.
not_for: Participation in another investigational study within the last month.
Brain metastases or history of leptomeningeal carcinomatosis.
Active or prior autoimmune or inflammatory disorders, with listed exceptions.
Active hepatitis, or HIV not well controlled.
Live attenuated vaccine within 30 days before first dose, or pregnancy or breastfeeding.
